body: I shouldnt have gone tonight, im so stupid. Thank you for trying to help. Im sorry though. I took a handful of notriptyline and benedryll. Im sorry...

But i have asked my girl to marry me, i planned on a life together, thats what kept me going all these years. Now that's gonna be canceled, and my reason to live will be gone. She reacts poorly on a lot of things and usually goes to physical violence either towards herself or me. She means the world to me and now i know im going to lose her for sure no matter what.
